notes.title: Silverwood Bay: An Eleanor Grey Mystery is Available Now!
notes.content:
Mystery writer Eleanor Grey has just moved from the big city to Silverwood Bay in search of inspiration for her next novel, but it doesn’t take long for the inspiration to find her! Embark on a thrilling hidden object adventure with "Silverwood Bay: An Eleanor Grey Mystery"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881759/b44eec06e01f3a74c85da5014f74e70cc7a54e8f.gif

Explore captivating scenes filled with hidden clues and uncover the truth behind the old brooch and romantic note found in a mysterious package from her friend Josie.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881759/987aa8bf4eea1556b1660b68c39f79d06a7af324.gif

Features

 Follow the story of Eleanor Grey
 Solve a Romance Mystery
 Go on an Adventure in Silverwood Bay
 28 chapters with 1-2 sub scenes
 28 subgames relating to the story

Collector's Edition

 7 Epilogue chapters
 7 Epilogue chapter wallpapers
 Music player


Join Eleanor as she unravels the secrets of Silverwood Bay and brings her long-awaited story to life in this immersive hidden object game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2710080/Silverwood_Bay_An_Eleanor_Grey_Mystery/

notes.title: I Love Finding Critters - Cinco de Mayo Update
notes.content:
In this Cinco de Mayo update, enjoy 2 new beautiful hidden object scenes. Search for a variety of critters and objects while traveling through scenes inspired by Hidalgo and Jalisco, Mexico!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41938734/f34b6f0719fc3407e87fd7734824fe8072a58d3c.jpg

If you like playing I Love Finding Critters and other hidden object games, you may also like our upcoming game - Faircroft's Antiques: The Mountaineer’s Legacy. Add it to your wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823330/Faircrofts_Antiques_The_Mountaineers_Legacy/
